summary: The Mother of the Lord is honored as the first and chief among the saints in the communion of the Church. Her obedience and trust at the Annunciation made her a model of faith for all ages.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Mary, Mother of God as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Mary, Mother of God, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
